yearHint.open: You can close the year once December ends.
yearHint.ready: The year is over and can be closed.

banner.title: {{month}} is over. Close it?
banner.body: Closing it locks its numbers and blocks new transactions dated in {{month}}. You can reopen it anytime.

panel.monthIntro: Review how the month ended. Once closed, {{month}} becomes read-only.
panel.yearIntro: Review how the year ended. Once closed, {{year}} becomes read-only and its annual summary is locked.
panel.openMonthNote: {{month}} is still open. Closing the year also closes {{month}}.
panel.openMonthsNote: {{count}} months are still open. Closing the year also closes them.
panel.noTotals: There was no income or spending in this period.
panel.noBalances: No accounts were open in this period.
panel.balancesNote: These balances become the opening balance of the next period.
panel.balancesOk: All your accounts have a calculated balance
panel.monthRule: Transactions dated in {{month}} can't be created, edited or deleted.
panel.yearRule: Transactions dated in {{year}} can't be created, edited or deleted.
panel.lockedRule: Its reports and balances are locked.
panel.reopenRule: You can reopen it from the month selector whenever you need.
panel.monthDoneBody: Its numbers won't change. If you need to fix something, reopen it from the month selector.
panel.yearDoneBody: All 12 months are read-only. You can reopen the year from the period selector.

reopen.title: Reopen {{month}} {{year}}
reopen.body: You'll be able to create, edit and delete transactions in {{month}}. If you change anything, the following months' balances recalculate automatically.
reopen.yearBody: The year reopens, but its months stay closed until you reopen them one by one.
reopen.closedYear: {{year}} is closed. Reopening {{month}} also reopens the year until you close it again.
reopen.autoHint: It closes on its own on {{date}} at 12:00 a.m. Recommended.
reopen.manualHint: It stays open and we'll remind you on the Summary.
reopen.toastAuto: It closes on its own tomorrow.
reopen.toastManual: Close it from the month selector when you're done.

lockedDate.title: {{month}} {{year}} is closed
lockedDate.body: To save this {{type}} on {{month}} {{day}}, reopen the month. You can also record it with another date.

settings.title: Period closing
settings.body: Choose whether months close on their own. You can always reopen a month or year from the month selector.
settings.autoHint: If you don't close it, it closes on its own on the day you choose.
settings.year: Close the year when December closes
settings.yearHint: The annual close is done without an extra step.
settings.remind: Remind me on the Summary when a month ends
settings.remindHint: A quiet notice with the month's summary, never a notification.

history.empty: You haven't closed any period yet.

errors.PERIOD_PREVIOUS_OPEN: Close the previous months first: they close in order.

errors.PERIOD_CLOSE_DAY_INVALID: Choose one of the available days.
